---
pagetitle: "Furkan Bekdemir"
description: "Psychiatry resident and computational psychiatry researcher at Ondokuz Mayıs University."
---

# Furkan Bekdemir

::: {.lede}
Psychiatry resident at Ondokuz Mayıs University, Samsun. I design measurement
instruments together with engineering collaborators. I write the software and
the models that run on them. I use both to study how the brain decides what to
believe.
:::

## Current work {.k-head}

::: {.entry}
::: {.meta}
Residency thesis &middot; BAP04-B-2026-6538 &middot; [in preparation]{.status .pending}
:::
### Belief updating and sensory attenuation in schizophrenia {.title}

Whether delusions track a failure of belief revision, a failure to attenuate
self-generated sensation, or both. Beads task modelled with the Hierarchical
Gaussian Filter, alongside a force-matching task run on a device built for
the study. Supervised by Prof. Dr. Gökhan Sarısoy; registration pending.
:::

::: {.entry}
::: {.meta}
In design &middot; [protocol]{.status .pending}
:::
### Akathisia as active inference {.title}

Akathisia treated as an attempt to make the world fit the model instead of
fitting the model to the world. Aripiprazole is the instrument here: if
dopamine encodes the precision of prediction errors, a D2 partial agonist
should clamp that precision rather than simply lower it.
:::

::: {.entry}
::: {.meta}
In collection
:::
### Effort and reward in multiple sclerosis {.title}

Separating fatigue from depression in MS by modelling effort-based decisions,
in collaboration with the Department of Neurology.
:::
